name: How should I prepare my home before the tile installation crew arrives?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my home before the tile installation crew arrives?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before tile installers arrive, clear all furniture, appliances, and personal items from the workspace and establish a clear path to the entry door. Discuss where cutting equipment can be placed, such as a garage or outdoor covered area, since wet saws generate dust and water runoff. You should also verify that doors will clear the new floor height once the tile and backer board are installed, as doors may need to be trimmed after installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear all furniture and items from the room, ensure a clear pathway for equipment, and determine an outdoor or garage area where installers can set up cutting tools.
